balanceOf(address).details: DO NOT USE FOR ECONOMIC CHECKS — aggregate view only, exposed         for IERC20 compliance and UI/event consumers. Core code         (LendingPool, LiquidationProxy, StabilityPool) MUST call         `balanceOf(user, adapter)` instead.

burn(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: Caps at the user's per-market scaled balance to handle the         "repay max" pattern where `amount` may slightly exceed nominal         due to rounding.

decimals().details: Returns the decimals places of the token.

mint(address,address,uint256,uint256).details: `amountScaled = amount.rayDiv(index)`. Half-up rounding is         applied via the WadRayMath library.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token.

totalUserDebtAcrossMarkets(address).details: DO NOT USE FOR ECONOMIC CHECKS — aggregate view only. Core         protocol logic MUST use `balanceOf(user, adapter)`. Use this         for UI summary cards, event payloads, off-chain dashboards.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Always reverts: debt tokens are non-transferable.

balanceOf(address).notice: Aggregate nominal debt of `user` across every market.

balanceOf(address,address).notice: Nominal debt of `user` ON `adapter` at the current pool index.         This is the CANONICAL accessor — the single number the protocol         consults for HF checks, repay limits, and liquidation seizure         caps. Each market is independent: a user can have non-zero         debt on one adapter and zero on another.

burn(address,address,uint256,uint256).notice: Burn `amount` of nominal debt from `user` on `adapter`.

mint(address,address,uint256,uint256).notice: Mint `amount` of nominal debt to `user` on `adapter` at the         current `index`. Increments the per-market mapping AND the         per-user / global aggregates in lock-step.

scaledTotalSupply(address).notice: Per-market scaled supply (raw — not multiplied by index).

totalSupply().notice: Aggregate nominal debt across every market.

totalSupply(address).notice: Per-market nominal supply (multiplied by current index).

totalUserDebtAcrossMarkets(address).notice: Aggregate nominal debt of `user` across every market.

transfer(address,uint256).notice: Always reverts: debt tokens are non-transferable.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Always reverts: debt tokens are non-transferable.
